D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.PerfectMatchings.CanonicalPairListing.canonical_mate
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: theorem canonical_mate {n : ℕ} (p : P n) (i : Fin n) : p.val (canonicalListing p ⟨2 * i.val, by omega⟩) = canonicalListing p ⟨2 * i.val + 1, by omega⟩

D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S0.Certificates.Combinatorics.NormalizedPfaffianCount.inversionCrossNestEquiv
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: noncomputable def inversionCrossNestEquiv {n : ℕ} (s : Equiv.Perm (Pos n)) (hs : s ∈ normalizedListings n) : InvType s ≃ CrossType (pairingOfListing s) ⊕ (NestType (pairingOfListing s) × Fin 2) where toFun

D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S0.Certificates.Combinatorics.NormalizedPfaffianCount.inversion_card_eq_cross_add_two_nesting_card
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: theorem inversion_card_eq_cross_add_two_nesting_card {n : ℕ} (s : Equiv.Perm (Pos n)) (hs : s ∈ normalizedListings n) : Fintype.card (InvType s) = Fintype.card (CrossType (pairingOfListing s)) + 2 * Fintype.card (NestType (pairingOfListing s))

D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.PerfectMatchings.CanonicalPairListing.listingEquiv
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: noncomputable def listingEquiv (n : ℕ) : {s : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * n)) // s ∈ normalizedListings n} ≃ P n where toFun s

D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.PerfectMatchings.CanonicalPairListing.listing_value_canonical
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: theorem listing_value_canonical {n : ℕ} (f : Fin (2 * n) → Fin (2 * n) → ℤˣ) (hf : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → f y x = -f x y) (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * n))) : listingValue f s = listingValue f (canonicalListing (pairingOfListing s))

D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.name: D5.S0.Certificates.Combinatorics.NormalizedPfaffianCount.pfaffian_eq_crossing_sum
D5/S0/Certificates/Combinatorics/Normali.signature: theorem pfaffian_eq_crossing_sum {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix (Pos n) (Pos n) R) : pfaffian A = ∑ s ∈ normalizedListings n, crossingCoefficient (pairingOfListing s) * (∏ a : lowerEndpoints (pairingOfListing s), A a.val ((pairingOfListing s).val a.val))
